claim: Logs food and drink against a calorie and macro target computed from height, weight, age and activity; record kept on the phone
Open-source for Android and iOS; installed from App Store and Google Play
GPLv3 licence badge; written in Dart (pubspec)
Food sources: Open Food Facts, USDA FoodData Central, German BLS; barcode scanner; quick add
Micronutrient panel for ten nutrients: fibre, sodium, saturated fat, sugar, calcium, iron, potassium, vitamin D, B12, magnesium
Water chip, optional fasting timer, recipes, weight history
No account; AES-256 encrypted storage, key in Android Keystore or iOS Keychain
JSON and CSV export, JSON import, QR sharing
Backend is its own open repository you can self-host
Platform badge lists Android and iOS only
